1. **[blocking][issue-impact]** `crates/jit/src/storage/redo_apply.rs:167` stages puts with `Dir::create` at a predictable `.{leaf}.{pid}.redo.tmp` name. That API opens an existing entry with create+truncate and follows symlinks. A pre-existing in-root symlink at that stage name can therefore overwrite an unrelated file, then be renamed onto the requested target—so the record writes a path it did not name and fails to reliably replace the put target. Use no-follow, collision-resistant create-new staging and add coverage for a pre-existing staged entry. References: `@/charter/D-17`, `@/invariant/atomic-writes`.
